title: Ho Saka Na Ambiyaa se Kaam Ashger Kar Gaya
body:
Ho saka na ambiyaa se kaam ashger kar gaya
Gham ki duniya ka qu laasa daste Sarwar pa kiya
1.Tashna kaami hai mili baatil ke lashkar ko yahain
Kahgaya sab kuch ishroo mein faqat ek be zuban
Jeete ji ashgar tumara aaj qatit margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Dusman a ne haq ne dekha pyaas mein shah umam
Khusq hootoun pa tabassam tha chala teer e sitam
Nouke naiza par bulad ashger tumara sar howa
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Kis tarha se dekhi hogi maa yeh manzar Fatima
Chal raha tha haiq qe ashger par jo khajer Fatima
Teer jis par ek chala tha us pa khajer chal gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Aalam e islam ne dekha na aisa aaj tak
Phir howa na is jahan mein aisa baccha aaj tak
Muskura kar teer khana be zubaan ka kaam tha
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Sun ne wala ab sune is ko bade hi ghour se
Woh Anees o ghalib o Iqbal hai is daur ke
Jisne bhi ashgar tumhara haal ka nouha lekha
Azz...Iqbal Abedi
